name: Thalassian Base Camp
summary: Tucked onto a high ridge in northern Azshara, the Thalassian Base Camp serves as the staging ground for an expedition of blood elves unearthing ancient arcane relics. Though initially funded under an agreement with the Horde, the camp's leadership quickly broke faith once digging commenced. Now, amidst their red pavilions and pulverized magical artifacts, darker summoning practices hint at their true objectives.

sections.title: A Fractured Accord
sections.body: The blood elf expedition nestled east of Ursolan was not supposed to be hostile to travelers from Orgrimmar. Their leader, Magus Rimtori, negotiated a formal pact with the Horde: in exchange for supply lines, funding, and armed escort through Azshara's treacherous wildlands, her researchers would share whatever magical riches they uncovered. Instead, as soon as the base camp was fortified and the first relics were pried from the elven ruins, Rimtori reneged entirely, driving away Horde emissaries. While Rimtori searches deeper reaches with an armed retinue, Magister Hawkhelm keeps watch over the ridge, guarding the encampment against retribution.

sections.title: Dust and Demonology
sections.body: The blood elves did not come merely to catalog history. They possess an unusual technique for pulverizing recovered magical curios into Glittering Dust—a refined powder distinctly different from common enchanting residue, which has already caught the curiosity of Archmage Xylem. More alarmingly, higher up the camp's ridges sits a Kaldorei Tome of Summoning. Far from an academic study of Highborne relics, the tome reveals a sinister willingness to pierce the veil and summon demonic entities directly into the ruins of Azshara.

faq.q: Why are blood elves here in Azshara?
aliases: why are there blood elves in azshara
faq.answer: They are part of an arcane excavation led by Magus Rimtori. They traveled across Kalimdor to exploit the ruins of ancient Kalimdor for potent magical artifacts, seeking power to harvest and siphon in the wake of the Sunwell's destruction.

faq.q: Why is the Horde hostile to this camp?
aliases: why do horde attack thalassian base camp
faq.answer: Magus Rimtori took Horde coin and resources under the promise of sharing the expedition's discoveries. Once her forces were safely established in northern Azshara, she broke the agreement, refused any tribute, and left the Horde looking for revenge.

faq.q: Who leads the Thalassian Base Camp?
faq.answer: The overarching leader of the expedition is Magus Rimtori, though she frequently ventures across Azshara flanked by personal bodyguards. In her absence, day-to-day command of the camp falls to Magister Hawkhelm.

It is an arcane residue produced through the blood elves' specialized method of crushing enchanted relics. Unlike the standard dust gathered through traditional enchanting disenchantment, its unique properties have drawn the keen interest of the eccentric Archmage Xylem.

faq.q: What is the Kaldorei Tome of Summoning on the ridge?
faq.answer: Perched on a ridge overlooking the camp, this ancient tome can be used to call forth demons into the area. Its presence exposes that Rimtori's expedition is dabbling in far darker pursuits than simple historical recovery.

angles.text: The Horde does not take broken oaths lightly; Magus Rimtori took your coin and gave back only treachery, making this camp an active target for retribution.
The blood elves' unique refinement of artifacts into Glittering Dust offers a rare, if dangerous, glimpse into Thalassian techniques that interest even Archmage Xylem.
